subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose raw token, cost, quota-window, and freshness/source metadata through `session_status.details.usage`, or should this become a separate agent-facing usage tool/API?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the stable response shape, privacy boundary, and quota/freshness semantics are product-owned API decisions.

options.title: Extend session_status details
options.body: Add a stable `details.usage` contract to the existing tool while preserving the rendered status card and current visibility checks.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower agent-facing usage query surface backed by the existing gateway/transcript usage code.

options.title: Keep status display-only
options.body: Leave raw usage behind gateway/UI/CLI surfaces and document that agents should not consume it through `session_status`.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status details
recommendation.body: Add a stable `details.usage` contract to the existing tool while preserving the rendered status card and current visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `session_status` and has recent/current history on status and provider-usage surfaces.
